The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their tall, cylindrical heads that ended in points, with small, solid [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] set low on their faces. At least three members of this species were present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CW21" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="FF-2014 6">{{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} dates the [[Hunt for the Decimator]], the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], the [[First Battle of Kamino]], the [[battle of Ohma-D'un]], the [[battle of Pengalan IV]], ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', and the events of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' up until the [[Battle of Hypori]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in that order.</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
